why_ai: AI Overviews already intercept the clicks and generated content competes; original reporting and voices remain.
why_clarity: Which journalism builds a durable audience is unmeasured and judged editorially.
why_digital: Web-first stories produced in a CMS and monetised through online ads and subscriptions.

why_ai: Yield, latency and format optimisation across programmatic partners is machine-run already.
why_clarity: Yield and page latency are measured per impression, though reader-return effects are slower.
why_digital: Header bidding and ad configuration are entirely software operations.

why_ai: Pricing an archive for AI buyers is novel negotiation with legal exposure, and demand grows because of AI.
why_clarity: No rights infrastructure or price benchmark exists, and each licensing deal is bespoke.
why_digital: Rights inventory and archives are digital; deals are negotiated by business development and legal.

why_ai: Link management, refresh and attribution are mechanical tasks automation handles well.
why_clarity: Link health and commission per link are directly measurable and recur across thousands of pages.
why_digital: Affiliate links, product data and commissions are all online records.

why_ai: The reading and revenue record already exists, so valuation is an analytics product.
why_clarity: Whether a piece built a durable reader shows up only months later through retention.
why_digital: Reading logs and revenue data analysed and reported on screen.

why_ai: Per-reader access decisions are a standard optimisation problem over recorded behaviour.
why_clarity: Conversion is instant but whether converted subscribers stay is known three months later.
why_digital: Paywall rules run in software on every online page view.

why_ai: Traffic forecasting and conversion are automatable, though the strategic response needs editorial judgement.
why_clarity: Platform changes arrive unannounced, so forecasts and responses are judged after the fact.
why_digital: Referral traffic, newsletters and conversion flows are entirely online.

why_ai: Reconciling exchange, network and publisher logs is a data-matching job for software.
why_clarity: Per-page revenue reconciles against payouts, though intermediaries hide some margins.
why_digital: Impression logs and partner reports are digital records reconciled on screen.

why_ai: Causal inference over complete reading histories is a modelling task, not a protected human role.
why_clarity: Methods for separating cause from selection disagree, and retention outcomes take months.
why_digital: Reading histories and subscription events are entirely digital.

why_ai: Ranking-change detection and traffic forecasting are automatable; diagnosing opaque platforms still needs judgement.
why_clarity: Ranking changes are diagnosed from folklore and forums rather than an agreed method.
why_digital: Platform traffic, dashboards and distribution all live on screen.

why_ai: Original reporting from sources needs novel judgement, but AI drafting and referral loss squeeze the role.
why_clarity: Each story is one-off and its contribution to the business is unmeasured.
why_digital: Stories start from sources and interviews, then are written and published online.
